name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What's missing or awkward today? Describe the situation that prompted this
request — a real crawling scenario is more useful than an abstract one.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? If you have an idea of the API/config shape
(a new CLI flag, config key, or class), sketch it out.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Links, examples from similar tools (Scrapy, Firecrawl, Crawl4AI, …), or anything
else that helps explain the request.
